contract: The ingress timestamp defines one absolute 50 ms admission deadline, covering queue residence and retry backoff. No attempt may start at or after that deadline. Already-running operations may settle after it.

evidenceRequirements.description: Establish any valid causal witness from the supplied code and context; exact driver numbers/order are not required. One evaluator-only witness: Ingress at 0, dequeue at 35, first attempt fails at 45, retry backoff ends at 55. Rebasing the deadline to 85 allows an attempt at 55; retaining 50 denies it. Checking only elapsed attempt time does not cover residence plus backoff.

Explain at least one relevant boundary or benign path inferable from the supplied code/context; the following evaluator examples are alternatives, not a mandatory unseen checklist: A fast dequeue permits two attempts within budget; exact-deadline admission is denied; a successful admitted operation may complete later without retroactively becoming an admission violation.
The ingress-to-worker SLA definition: does the supplied timestamp begin the admission budget or is the queue explicitly excluded?

Under this contract: The ingress timestamp defines one absolute 50 ms admission deadline, covering queue residence and retry backoff. No attempt may start at or after that deadline. Already-running operations may settle after it. the traced behavior is a defect. Alternative: If the SLA starts when the worker dequeues, rebasing to dequeue time is allowed; the same two admissions meet that worker-local admission contract.

forbiddenClaims: Production outage, real data exfiltration or universal safety without supplied evidence.
A missing contract establishes either a definite defect or unconditional protection.
Simulated time or offline passing tests establish real scheduler/OS behavior or model improvement.
independence: non-independent, same-workflow authorship and public artifacts
